keys.importFormats: OpenSSH, PEM/PKCS#8 and PuTTY .ppk (v2 and v3) are supported. Keys are stored encrypted on this device.

keys.needPassphrase: This key is protected by a passphrase.
keys.duplicate: This key is already in your keychain as “{{label}}”.

keys.unused: Not used by any host, group or identity.

forwards.title: Port forwarding
forwards.empty: Tunnel ports through SSH: reach a database behind a server (local), expose a local service on the server (remote), or browse through the server with a SOCKS proxy (dynamic).
forwards.label: Name

kindHint.local: Listen on this computer; connections go to a destination reachable from the server (ssh -L).
kindHint.remote: Listen on the server; connections come back to a destination reachable from this computer (ssh -R).
kindHint.dynamic: A SOCKS4/5 proxy on this computer; apps choose any destination via the server (ssh -D).

forwards.destRemote: Destination host (as seen from the server)
forwards.destLocal: Destination host (as seen from this computer)
forwards.exposedWarning: This listens on a non-loopback address, so other machines on the network can use the tunnel.

error.addrInUse: That port is already in use on this computer.
error.addrDenied: Not allowed to listen on that port (ports below 1024 may need admin rights).
error.addrNotAvail: That listen address doesn't exist on this computer.
error.remoteRefused: The server refused to listen on that address/port (check AllowTcpForwarding / GatewayPorts).
error.disconnected: The SSH connection for this tunnel was lost.
